Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::ocr_backend_supports_language;

fn main() {
    let backend = r#"nonexistent-backend-xyz"#;
    let language = r#"eng"#;
    let result = ocr_backend_supports_language(backend, language);
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
